sections.heading: How We Shortlisted Ultralight Hiking Backpacks
body: This draft evaluates packs by weight-conscious design, support structure, capacity usefulness, trail reputation, price tier, and likely fit for backpackers who want to move faster with less burden.
Before publishing, an editor should verify product-level Amazon URLs, affiliate links, image references, and any final specification details used in the copy.

sections.heading: Buying Advice
body: The best ultralight backpack is not always the lightest one. Framing, torso fit, back-panel comfort, pocket layout, and real load transfer matter just as much as the headline weight.

Choose a more mainstream lightweight pack if comfort and versatility matter most. Choose a more specialized ultralight model if aggressive weight reduction is the top priority and you are comfortable with tradeoffs.
